_comment: Copy to ~/.mycohesity/endpoints.json to point the tools at the right URLs for
your MyCohesity tenant. Anything you omit falls back to the built-in default.
Easiest path: ask Claude to run mycohesity_discover_endpoints, click through the
portal, then ask it to save the endpoints it found with mycohesity_set_endpoint.
mode         'page' renders the Lightning UI in a headless browser and scrapes
links and tables out of it. 'api' issues a JSON request over the
stored session cookies -- much faster, but only works if you know
result_path  api mode only -- dotted path to the record list inside the JSON
wait_selector page mode only -- CSS selector to wait for before scraping.
Useful for Lightning pages that populate their tables late.
